pattern: a fit above 500 mm: Python fails the part's rules, Rust answers (Q8)
evidence: Python's rules fail the whole part with fit_limits' 'nominal size 558.8 outside 0-500 mm': the part has a Ø558.8 (22 in) diameter, which is offered fits, and describing them for the question list raises (docs/questions.md Q8 records the same failure at 600 mm). The maintainer's decision Q8 extends ISO 286 to 3150 mm in both engines; the Rust rules tabulate it (ISO 286-1:2010 Tables 1-3, checked in tests/standards.rs), so questions, defaults, preview, apply and problems answer for this part from Python's own analysis. Python has no output to compare these with; when specify-core's extension (branch iso286-3150) is captured, the oracle compares them and this entry goes stale.
